google.formatted_address: Book Tower, 1265 Washington Blvd Suite #200, Detroit, MI 48226, USA

samples.author: shalesDC
samples.text: WOW, just wow. The fact that they have a place so incredible like this in the heart of downtown Detroit is so special. It makes you want to live here! The views are beautiful, the cocktails are good and the dimly lit atmosphere at night is absolutely romantic. From the moment you walk into the building you are engulfed with incredible views of a historic building preserved and maintained to show its original excellence. Walk up to the concierge desk where they will tell you to take the elevator up to Kampers and you won't be disappointed. I wish it would have been warmer weather for a romantic rooftop experience- next time! This was all around, my favorite experience in Detroit.

samples.author: FriedChicken
samples.text:
Of course Kamper's is five star. On one of the top level of historic Book tower, it offers small plates, drinks, and panoramic views of downtown Detroit. Everything was so good. Food was fresh, house cocktails were on point. Bartender/server is very knowledge of their menu and provided recommendations. Styling of the lounge is warm and comfortable. And of course the skyline is immaculate at night.

Usually they need a reservation but I walked in during middle of winter where it was 10degree outside so there were not a lot of customers.

samples.author: Morgan B
samples.text: Super beautiful view!! Kampers is in the lovely book tower with plenty other places to check out but this one is a must. The staff members we met from the hostess who escorted us to the elevator up to the rooftop, our waitress and the bartenders were all lovely people. Drinks were good but the show stopper is definitely the view and atmosphere 😁.

samples.author: Carter Clark
samples.text: Kamper’s feels like a refined escape right in the heart of Detroit, beautifully set inside the iconic Book Tower. The space has a warm and inviting charm, blending elegance with comfort in a way that instantly puts you at ease. The views from outside are impressive and make the experience feel special, even if you step out briefly just to take it all in. Every dish and drink feels thoughtfully prepared and satisfying. What truly elevates the visit is the attentive and friendly team, whose positive energy makes the entire experience memorable. Definitely a place that leaves a lasting impression and earns a solid five star rating.

samples.author: Sherri Jackson
samples.text: Came here with a group of friends to have tapas and cocktails. We made a reservation because of our group size(7). However, I believe they can accommodate couples or smaller groups without one. Love the ambience of this place. Sophisticated vibe which lends itself to any type of event, dressy, casual, romantic night with your significant other or just hanging out with friends or family. Ample indoor and outdoor rooftop seating. Umbrellas and fire pits with a beautiful backdrop of the city. I will definitely be returning.
